newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume steady.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume steady.

text.p: Istanbul gold prices ended mixed on Wednesday and volume was steady at 703 kilos as banks were the main players amid weak free market demand, dealers said.
Gold closed at $378.90 an ounce, down from $379.70 on Tuesday, following European trends. But it rose to 1,193,250 lira per gram from yesterday's 1,192,250 due to a weak lira.

The lira dived to a low of 98,140 against the dollar from Tuesday's 97,340 close, but firmed to 97,700 at close after the central bank sold dollars for lira to banks to curb the U.S. currency's rise buoyed by cash surplus earlier in the day.
Volume was 337 kilos in the second session after 366 in the morning. 84 percent of the total turnover was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75 EKS
